title: New faces for old foes
text:
The Tidecaller, the Bog Witch and Vyrathos get brand-new models.

✨ Tidecallers at Mirrowmere are now hooded undead magi with a glowing skull and spellbook, floating as they cast
✨ Bog Witches in Gloamfen are now horned moon-sorceresses with crescent staves
✨ Vyrathos, the Ember Tyrant is now a huge black dragon: it breathes, shifts its weight and beats its wings, lunges to bite and falls when slain
⬆️ On the Low graphics setting these keep their classic look so the game stays fast
